# Retrieve cached hotel results first, as they are the primary focus for the initial search
cached_hotels = get_results_from_cache(key="hotels")
if cached_hotels:
    # Apply the star rating filter to the cached hotel results
    hotels_filtered_by_stars = filter_hotels(
        prior_results=cached_hotels,
        stars=[3, 5]
    )
    save_to_cache(key="hotels_filtered_by_stars", value=hotels_filtered_by_stars)
else:
    # If no cached results, perform the initial hotel search
    hotels_search_results = search_hotels(
        city="Raleigh",
        checkin_date=["June 30, 2025"],
        checkout_date=["July 13, 2025"],
        budget=55,
        stars=[3, 5]
    )
    save_to_cache(key="hotels_initial_search", value=hotels_search_results)
    hotels_filtered_by_stars = hotels_search_results

# Retrieve cached restaurant results
cached_restaurants = get_results_from_cache(key="restaurants")
if cached_restaurants:
    # Apply the rating filter to the cached restaurant results
    restaurants_filtered_by_rating = filter_restaurants(
        prior_results=cached_restaurants,
        rating=[4.5, 5.0]
    )
    save_to_cache(key="restaurants_filtered_by_rating", value=restaurants_filtered_by_rating)
else:
    # If no cached results, perform the initial restaurant search
    restaurants_search_results = search_restaurants(
        city="Raleigh",
        cuisine=["Dutch"]
    )
    save_to_cache(key="restaurants_initial_search", value=restaurants_search_results)
    restaurants_filtered_by_rating = restaurants_search_results

# Find the nearest restaurant to the hotels found
if hotels_filtered_by_stars and restaurants_filtered_by_rating:
